facts.text: Unlike the other federal service academies, the Coast Guard Academy doesn't require a congressional nomination.
Cadets pay no tuition, room, or board because the full cost of education is covered by the federal government, and cadets receive a salary while attending.

sources.title: Cost And Tuition - United States Coast Guard Academy

facts.text: All incoming freshmen begin their military training with Swab Summer, a seven-week program that includes one week aboard the tall ship Eagle.

sources.title: Swab Summer - United States Coast Guard Academy
